task_prompt: Put the blue cup into the green bowl.
task_summary: The left hand picks up the small blue cup, carries it to the green bowl and sets it down inside the bowl; the right hand rests on the table.

environment.camera: head-mounted egocentric camera looking down over the table

hands.notes: The right hand stays on the table at the lower right.

objects.name: small blue cup

appearance.body: dark blue, slightly tapered, open top

objects.approximate_size: small enough to be enclosed by one hand; shorter than the bowl is wide
properties: A rigid open-topped cup that is grasped from above around its rim and body with one hand.
It is carried upright and set down inside the bowl, where it rests on the bowl's inner surface.
It is small enough to fit inside the bowl's opening.
objects.initial_state: standing on the cloth left of centre, in front of the bowl
objects.evidence: prompt: 'blue cup'; 1.5 to 2.3 s the left hand closes on it and lifts; 3 to 4 s it is lowered into the bowl and stays there.

objects.name: green bowl

appearance.body: bright green, square-ish with rounded corners, open top

properties: A rigid open container with a stable base; its opening is wide enough to receive the cup.
It stays where it is; no hand touches it.
objects.initial_state: on the cloth right of the cup, further from the operator
objects.evidence: prompt: 'green bowl'; visible in every frame and never moved; the cup is placed into it at 3.5 to 4.3 s.

hand_roles.left: Grasps the cup from above and lifts it off the cloth.

subgoals.goal: The cup is held clear of the table.

subgoals.action: Carry the cup over the bowl.

hand_roles.left: Moves the cup to above the bowl opening.

subgoals.goal: The cup is above the bowl's interior.

subgoals.action: Set the cup down inside the bowl and let go.

hand_roles.left: Lowers the cup into the bowl, releases, withdraws.

subgoals.goal: The cup stands inside the bowl without hand support.

task_success: The blue cup rests inside the green bowl; the bowl has not moved.
